lyrics:
[00:09.64] [Intro]
(Wheezy Beats)
[Chorus]
[00:11.69] Who can you tell? Who can you tell?
[00:15.16] Who can you tell when you're all by yourself?
[00:18.83] Who can you tell? Who can you tell?
[00:22.38] Who can you tell when you're all by yourself?
[Verse]
[00:25.70] Oh-oh, I really wanna let my mind go
[00:28.38] I served all my time (Yeah), layin' in bed with my eyes closed
[00:32.16] Too much on my brain (Yeah), I try not to complain (Yeah)
[00:35.75] Feelin' like I'm going insane (Yeah), but life just ain't the same (Same)
[Bridge]
[00:40.61] Woke up in hell, the devil prevailed
[00:44.16] I know him well and that's easy to tell (Tell)
[00:48.00] Locked in his jail, stuck in a cell
[00:51.28] Just the two of us (Us), me and myself (Me and myself)
[Chorus]
[00:55.17] Who can you tell? Who can you tell?
[00:58.80] Who can you tell when you're all by yourself?
[01:02.46] Who can you tell? Who can you tell?
[01:06.12] Who can you tell when you're all by yourself?
[01:09.90] Who can you tell? Who can you tell?
[01:13.31] Who can you tell when you're all by yourself?
[01:16.95] Who can you tell? Who can you tell?
[01:20.59] Who can you tell when you're all by yourself?
title: Who Can You Tell?
author: Juice WRLD
